## About
Comal Pest Control was established by owner Harvey Kalich to serve New Braunfels and Comal County. Some of the local merchants, organizations and families we work with have called on us since the day we opened.
We handle the inside and outside of homes and businesses, from new construction to historic landmarks. Along with general pest and termite work, we take care of lawns, trees and ornamental plants.
Neighbors have rated us 5 stars across 23 Google reviews. One customer put it simply: no frills, just good work.

## Services
- General pest control: Cockroaches, ants, spiders, silverfish, scorpions, wasps, hornets, bees, carpenter ants, earwigs, millipedes, centipedes, mosquitoes, ticks, fleas, crickets, flies, moths and weevils.
- Termite inspections: We look for damaged or hollow-sounding wood, mud tubes, pinholes in drywall or wallpaper, and piles of small wings, and give you advice on protecting your structures.
- Termite control: Options may include exterior protection, bait stations, liquid borate applied to wood, or foam injected into walls where activity is found.
- Termite pretreatment for new building: Planning a new structure or an addition? We can treat for termites before construction.
- Wood destroying insect reports: Inspections and reports for real estate sales.
- Lawn, ornamental and tree care: Tree spraying for caterpillars, webworms, ball moss, aphids and mites, plus fungus treatment, root feeding, tree injection, yard fertilization and pre- and post-emergent weed control.
- Rodents and wildlife: Rodents, skunks and raccoons.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on homes and businesses?
A: Yes. We handle residential and commercial properties, inside and out, including new construction and historic buildings.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Call, email or fill out the contact form, and one of our certified applicators will come to your location, look things over and give you an estimate.

Q: What can I do to lower the chance of termites?
A: Limit the conditions termites like: wood touching the ground, excess moisture, gutters or A/C lines draining next to the slab, bark mulch or wood piles against the house, and poor drainage.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed on weekends.
